rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
optative expressing the unrealized effect of cutting
compound indicating attainment or absorption in that state
bahuvrihi compound describing one whose mind is directed to that
comparative particle introducing the illustrative condition

items.question: Can absorption in that state prevent harm when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of cutting.
A person can be absorbed in that state with mind fixed on it.
Such absorption renders the person unaffected by the cutting.
items.inference: One who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on that remains uncut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' (tad) is implicit from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has attained that state and whose mind is fixed on it, though being cut, is not cut.
